skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Quadrangle
skins.content:
Vitafield
[Rewilder] Series Classics/Quadrangle. Waterproof, dirt-resistant, and lightweight.
skins.usage: One of Cuora's special work clothes.
skins.quote: You may forget where you came from, but not where you are going to.

skins.name: Amongst Lotuses
skins.content: 0011 Yun Series New Arrivals/Amongst Lotuses. Summer clothes inspired by lotus flowers, made for Cuora by Yanese artisans. Only after countless back-and-forths with the client did the backpack's design finally receive her approval.
skins.quote: 'Wow! The flowers in the water are so pretty, and the goldfins are too! If I take some back, every day will be as bright as summer! ...Err, what did I come here to get again?'
